proof: tests/audit/test_spec_refusal.py passes without xfail (unknown strategy, unsupported spec version, rows over the manifest limit, imaging requested where the profile declares scalar output only, unknown output modality, spec profile mismatch, and attempt-bound mismatch each refused before any model call with a durable refused run record; matching specs normalise to identical digests; a mismatched source pin fails intake with zero model calls); tests/engine/test_spec_cli.py passes (a --spec file restating the defaults runs byte-identical payloads with identical spec digests; contradicting/unreadable spec files, unknown profiles, and imaging on the scalar-only profile are refused with no model invocation and a durable record); plan-schema tests pass (supported strategies accepted, out-of-spec proposals rejected, repair prompts carry only supported options); tests/engine/test_evidence_report.py passes (stored values render verbatim, required/optional status shown, released runs ship the report in the run directory and the ZIP with matching digests, failing runs write the report with no decision); full pytest 454 passed; force_pass 12/12 exit 0; clean-archive gate exit 0; CP-02 deliberately versioned the PDD446 seed-42 golden artifact be9e26d7e664 to 55eb1c22e212 (TIR transition repair; verdict pass). Fixed-plan replay (LP-02): `ruloom run --plan saved/plan.json` validates the saved plan against the same spec-supported bounds and stores it with no planner call, so two replays of one plan yield byte-identical data.csv bytes (tests/engine/test_plan_replay.py: hylogger + tabular replay match, zero planner calls, non-object and schema-invalid plans refused before generation; the differing release ZIPs assert the ZIP is not the reproducibility comparator).
title: Versioned GenerationSpec with bounded plan/repair and evidence report
